# Cres Dynamics Ltd

> Cres Dynamics Ltd is a software engineering company in Nairobi, Kenya. It builds AI systems that forecast sales, stock and cash flow 3 to 6 months ahead, AI advisor agents for directors, business operating systems, custom ERP, school management systems, logistics AI and high-end ecommerce websites. Systems it has built run in more than 10 countries, including Kenya, Tanzania, Mauritius, South Africa and the United States.

Key facts:
- Offices: Westlands (Kivuli Tower, 3rd Floor) since January 2026, and Rongai (Ole Kasasi, opposite Manna Bible College), Nairobi, Kenya.
- Contact: info@cresdynamics.com, +254 708 805 496.
- Pricing: custom. Every system is quoted to its scope; email info@cresdynamics.com for a proposal.
- Ownership: clients own the code, the data and the hosting accounts.
- Banking partners: Stanbic Bank, Co-operative Bank, I&M Bank.
- Clients include Smart Brands, Cyber Hub, Gadget Hub Investments, Strive Creative (South Africa), Millenia, House of Procurement and SAG Agro (Tanzania, Kenya, Mauritius).
- Integrations: M-Pesa, card payments, bank feeds, WhatsApp.

## Systems

- [AI systems and AI agents](https://cresdynamics.com/ai-systems): AI systems for companies in Kenya, from audit to rollout.
- [AI forecasting for directors](https://cresdynamics.com/ai-forecasting): predicts sales, cash flow and demand 3 and 6 months ahead; AI advisor agents brief executives on what to do next.
- [Logistics AI](https://cresdynamics.com/logistics-ai): predicts stock and market shifts, payment and spoilage alerts, when to discount and which products to bring in.
- [AI automation](https://cresdynamics.com/ai-automation): AI agents that answer clients 24/7, qualify leads and follow up invoices.
- [Business operating system](https://cresdynamics.com/services/business-operating-system): finance, CRM, HR and multi-branch operations in one system.
- [CresOS](https://cresdynamics.com/cresos): the modular foundation Cres Dynamics tailors into each client's business operating system.
- [Multi-branch business system](https://cresdynamics.com/multi-branch-business-system): per-branch stock, sales, staff and cash with group consolidation.
- [Custom ERP](https://cresdynamics.com/erp): HR, finance, procurement, inventory and sales with M-Pesa.
- [School management system](https://cresdynamics.com/school-management-system): M-Pesa fees, admissions, CBC report cards, attendance and parent portal.
- [Ecommerce websites](https://cresdynamics.com/e-commerce): M-Pesa and card checkout, stock sync and delivery tracking.
- [High-end websites](https://cresdynamics.com/websites): fast, search-optimised business websites.
